g.text: Each job can use another model: an id on the main provider, provider:model (anthropic:claude-haiku-5-5), or server:<name>[/model].
reads untrusted web and MCP text
answers when the main one is down
--ladder a,b,c: start on the cheapest model.
When trouble adds up: 1 reflect, 2 start
again from a note, 3 move up a model.
or when the main model is down (fallback)
A worker on another model that stops or returns nothing hands its part
back; the main agent does it. After 2 failures that job runs on the main model.
About ten short requests (typed calls, calls written as text, recovery,
window, cache). It says which jobs the model can take; --write saves it.
Each model keeps its own settings
window, tier (local, mid, frontier), toolChoice, thinkingBudget, keepThinking,
